day_shape: 76 items: Trump leaves door open to Iran strikes after no-strike pledge, CENTCOM says 133 vessels redirected under Hormuz blockade, HRANA reports 2,003 Iranian executions in a year, two UK parliamentary questions tabled on Iran/IRGC.

threads.label: US pressure campaign and Hormuz blockade
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 133 commercial vessels enforcing a blockade on Iran, and Treasury Secretary Bessent outlined plans to target overland trade, crypto and shipping. Trump said "we may" strike Iran a day after ruling it out before midterms, while claiming the US had stopped Iran getting a nuclear weapon.

threads.label: Iran missile and nuclear capacity assessments
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Western intelligence assessments that Iran has preserved key weapons factories and can still produce missiles despite months of strikes. Iran International reported Iran is seeking more electricity from Turkey and Turkmenistan to offset war damage; Defa Press cited a National Interest piece calling Iran's nuclear knowledge "indestructible."

threads.label: Russia-Iran diplomatic channel
threads.summary: The Kremlin said Putin, in coordination with Pezeshkian, conveyed Iran's position to Trump during a phone call, per RIA Novosti and Jerusalem Post. Defa Press separately discussed a possible Yak-130M aircraft contract between Tehran and Moscow.

threads.label: Yemen, Houthis and Red Sea
threads.summary: UN officials told the Security Council Yemen has returned to full-scale war, and the UK's deputy permanent representative Kate Foster condemned Houthi escalation. IRIB claimed 587 flights at Riyadh's King Khalid airport were cancelled over three days following a Yemeni warning; the US Embassy in Jordan issued a travel advisory citing the Houthi Riyadh airport attack.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Gaza and Syria
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Syrian operative Yusuf Ali Al-Hassoun on the Syria-Lebanon border, describing him as acting under Iranian direction, and killed three Hamas and Islamic Jihad members in Gaza while dismantling four weapons facilities. A further IDF statement reported killing an armed figure who crossed the Yellow Line in northern Gaza.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and executions
threads.summary: HRANA reported Iran executed at least 2,003 people over the past year, a 29% rise, and Iran International reported a 17-year-old died in Isfahan custody after a Basij beating. The jailed wife of an executed protester is being pressured to deny her marriage, and a London court heard details of an alleged Iranian spy operation targeting Iran International.

threads.label: Khamenei/Pezeshkian security messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted on security as the "solid pillar" of the nation, and Defa Press amplified army and IRGC messaging including Major General Jahangshahi's claim that over 50 combat units are deployed on the borders. Pezeshkian posted on X that regional diplomacy must become a crisis-management tool, while Velayati attacked US Secretary of State Rubio over Iranian civilisation.
